subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the public `GET /sessions/:sessionKey/history` response transition from numeric `nextCursor` output to an opaque generation-aware cursor now, and what upgrade/documentation contract should existing consumers receive?
rationale: The bounded keyset design needs a stable anchor, but choosing whether existing consumers may observe a new cursor format is a public compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Adopt opaque cursors with an explicit contract
options.body: Keep legacy numeric input for the stated migration window, document opaque output as the supported continuation token, and add exact-head upgrade evidence.

options.title: Preserve numeric output temporarily
options.body: Retain numeric response cursors until a separately approved API transition, accepting that the bounded reader may need an alternate compatibility representation.

options.title: Pause visible-history adoption
options.body: Land only the parent foundation and defer HTTP/SSE cursor adoption until the public compatibility direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt opaque cursors with an explicit contract
recommendation.body: Keep legacy numeric input for the stated migration window, document opaque output as the supported continuation token, and add exact-head upgrade evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged active-projection and bounded-history foundation is the closest current-main ownership trail for this public history read path.
